projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: For me, projects are not only about learning and finding solutions, but also about creating things that truly help people and businesses. This real value is what makes them important. Here are some of my projects:

list.title: Personal Ops Center
list.description: A personal fullstack ecosystem with a Next.js dashboard, identity management, and AI-assisted document processing.
list.goal: Build a unified engineering ecosystem with a dashboard and five cooperating microservices.
list.implementation: The Next.js dashboard is integrated with Identity Service and Doc Intelligence. The current workflow includes JWT authentication and asynchronous PDF/DOCX processing with BullMQ and Redis.
list.result: The core authenticated dashboard and document-processing workflow are integrated, establishing the foundation for the remaining services.
list.status: Integrated: Identity Service and Doc Intelligence. In progress: Neural Assistant. Planned: Data Forge and Insight Aggregator.

list.title: DocSense API (.NET)
list.description: A backend API for intelligent document processing and AI-powered analysis. Built with ASP.NET Core and EF Core, featuring file upload handling, background job processing, usage limits, and Swagger documentation for easy integration and testing.

list.title: DocSense AI (MVP)
list.description: An intelligent document analysis system. Built with a modular architecture, it leverages AI for insights and Redis for high-performance data caching. Includes full Swagger documentation.
